mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.teams (id, name, slug, status, created_by_user_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{slug}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{createdByUserId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, slug, status, created_by_user_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM public.teams WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT t.id, t.name, t.slug, t.status, t.created_by_user_id, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.created_by, t.updated_by FROM public.teams t INNER JOIN public.team_members tm ON tm.team_id = t.id WHERE tm.user_id = #{userId} AND tm.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
